examples.en: Today I dressed up a bit and went to work.
That café is old and full of charm.
That singer sings well and is cool too.
Hanbok has a distinctly Korean charm.
How about this coat? — It looks great!

explain: ‘멋’은 보통 ‘멋있다’, ‘멋지다’로 써요. 남자에게도 여자에게도 쓸 수 있고, 예쁘다보다 ‘스타일 있다’는 느낌이에요.

dict_examples.en: He dressed up in a black suit, but still just looks countrified and frivolous.

explain_en: 멋 is usually used as 멋있다 or 멋지다. It works for men and women, and feels more like “stylish, cool” than “pretty”.
